rules.boundary_rules: Neighbour amenity, parking pressure, servicing and local shared-housing concentration are recurring pressure points for HMO proposals in Warwickshire.
rules.roof_rules: Roof rooms, dormers and upper-floor reconfiguration often need to be reviewed alongside the change of use rather than as a separate afterthought.
